svg.aria-label: Concurrency-adjusted effective cost trajectories and routine vs complex task split
svg.text: Multitasking Adjustment ($60/h ÷ k) & Structural Critique · Routine vs. Hard Tasks
How Developer Multitasking (k Concurrent Tasks) & Task Complexity Flip the Winner
Left: Effective cost rank across concurrency levels w_eff = $60/k. Right: Routine 3-task sum vs. complex regex engine cost at $60/h (k=1).
Routine 3 Tasks (bugfix + expr + csvstats) — claude-haiku-5.5 wins ($1.23 in 72.8s)
Complex Regex Task (1,523 fuzz cases) — claude-sonnet-5.5 wins ($1.04 in 51.7s)
Effective cost at $60/h (k=1) and wall-clock seconds
1. Concurrency Rule: For k = 1 or 2 concurrent tasks ($60/h or $30/h), claude-sonnet-5.5 is #1 ($2.39 and $1.46). For k ≥ 3 ($20/h or less), auto and gpt-6-luna win.
2. Complexity Split: claude-haiku-5.5 is #1 on the 3 routine tasks ($1.23, 72.8s) but spends 404.4s ($6.77) debugging regex, where claude-sonnet-5.5 takes 51.7s ($1.04).
